opener_episode.why: The Artelligence Podcast has no episodes since June 2023, so there is no recent Artelligence episode to reference. Maneker's Sept 2026 Puck appearance on the coming wave of boomer collections is his freshest on-record view and the best hook for a Wall Power story pitch.

angles.headline: Click & Mortar: the online blue-chip gallery model, ten years on
angles.pitch: Avery launched ArtLife.com in 2015 as one of the first online-only blue-chip galleries and scaled it to eight figures a year with social-first marketing plus curated pop-ups, data for Maneker's ongoing coverage of online sales and new buyers.
angles.builds_on: Artelligence/Wall Power coverage of online marketplaces (LiveArt episode) and art-market mechanics

angles.headline: Where the boomer supply goes: celebrity and new-money buyers at Art Basel Miami Beach
angles.pitch: Avery advises celebrities, athletes and HNW buyers (placed a $100K+ Hap Tivey with Kris Jenner at ABMB 2024, per Us Weekly), a ground-level view of who is buying as Maneker tracks the coming $1T supply.

angles.headline: Building an artist market outside the auction system
angles.pitch: How Avery developed Alec Monopoly into a global brand and championed Hebru Brantley and Jammie Holmes early, primary-market brand-building vs auction-led price discovery.
angles.builds_on: Artelligence's long-running market-making and auction-house coverage

booking.route: Podcast dormant; pitch Maneker as a source/story for Puck's Wall Power newsletter or for an appearance on a Puck podcast. Puck lists him as an author (puck.news/author/marion-maneker). No public booking email or form found; do not construct one.
booking.contact: unverified - best documented routes: Puck author page / Puck press, Substack (artelligence.substack.com) reply, or LinkedIn/X DM

format: Former format: interview podcast (presented by LiveArt) with collectors, dealers, auction specialists, advisors; 171 episodes May 2014 - June 2023; New York-based. Artelligence newsletter became Puck's paid 'Wall Power' (launched April 16, 2024). Maneker now appears as a guest on Puck's The Powers That Be.
